title: Distinguish endpoint and richer-record costs for a squared closure residual
statement: In a separate four-state family, detecting a squared closure residual q requires order q^-2 endpoint episodes, while intermediate observations of the same visible variable permit order q^-1 steps under a richer access contract.

evidence.quote: ## 6. Two constructive boundaries were also completed
evidence.range_scope: Two separate information-resource constructions: actuation budget/time and endpoint versus richer-record exponents. No cross-model transfer inferred.

requires: The source specific four-state family, definition of squared residual q, testing/confidence task and endpoint-episode contract allowing adaptive durations. Full definitions and proof are in the unacquired report.

The richer protocol retains intermediate observations of the same visible variable; that additional temporal record is a real access resource, not an algebraic transformation of the same endpoint data.
provides: Source-reported endpoint lower order q^-2 persists with adaptive endpoint lengths. A richer-record construction has order q^-1 steps, with an optimal same-access likelihood comparator and executed richer-record test reported.
assumptions: The two exponents use distinct observation contracts and source-specific counting units. No unrestricted same-access algorithmic superiority is claimed.
This family is separate from the exclusion network and the actuation-budget family. An algebraic squared residual is not automatically an inexpensive physical observation.
costs: Endpoint episodes/durations versus retained intermediate observations/steps; sampling/readout and confidence resources must be carried under the actual interface.
contract.units: q source squared closure residual; endpoint episodes versus richer-record steps, not interchangeable unit costs.
contract.obstruction: The claimed improvement requires richer observations. Missing physical measurement access or source family assumptions cannot be supplied by the residual formula alone.

body: Retains the source constructive observation boundary without inventing a general exponent theorem. Original proof, likelihood comparator and executed-test artifacts remain unacquired under P2 holds.
